  "title": "Unable to log in with MySQL 8.0.11; caching_sha2_password authentication method unknown to the client ",
  "body": "With MySQL 8.0.11 I'm unable to log in with users that had been working fine under previous versions (at least 8.0.0, perhaps even more recent than that).\r\n\r\n> mysqli_real_connect(): The server requested authentication method unknown to the client [caching_sha2_password]\r\n> \r\n> mysqli_real_connect(): (HY000/2054): The server requested authentication method unknown to the client\r\n\r\nSee also https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/authentication-plugins.html\r\n\r\nI'm using QA_4_8.",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2018-04-21T23:41:17Z",
  "updated_at": "2021-01-08T01:22:22Z",

      "body": "See also https://stackoverflow.com/questions/49948350/phpmyadmin-on-mysql-8-0"

    {
      "id": 383341604,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-383341604",
      "created_at": "2018-04-21T23:42:01Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "Possibly related: https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14217"
    },
    {
      "id": 383341644,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-383341644",
      "created_at": "2018-04-21T23:43:09Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "A point release seems like a bad time to make changes to the authentication protocols. I've been testing with 8.0.4-rc which works fine, and now that 8.0.11 is out it causes problems."
    },
    {
      "id": 383341944,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-383341944",
      "created_at": "2018-04-21T23:50:48Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=76243"
    },
    {
      "id": 385341547,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-385341547",
      "created_at": "2018-04-30T08:44:44Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "I met this issue a few days before, is there anyone who solve this problem?  thanks a lot~"
    },
    {
      "id": 388174849,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-388174849",
      "created_at": "2018-05-10T20:25:53Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "There is not much we can do about it right now, as apparently PHP still does not support the `caching_sha2_password` authentication method.\r\n\r\nHowever, I was able to connect successfully using other authentication methods such as `mysql_native_password` and `sha256_password`."
    },
    {
      "id": 390496185,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-390496185",
      "created_at": "2018-05-20T17:01:40Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "[https://stackoverflow.com/questions/49948350/phpmyadmin-on-mysql-8-0/50437307#50437307](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/49948350/phpmyadmin-on-mysql-8-0/50437307#50437307)"
    },
    {
      "id": 397137175,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-397137175",
      "created_at": "2018-06-14T01:22:07Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "PHP developers started adding `caching_sha2_password` support. Once a version of PHP with this support is released, we can add support for `caching_sha2_password` on our side as well."
    },
    {
      "id": 399516170,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-399516170",
      "created_at": "2018-06-22T17:17:58Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 6",
      "body": "Upgrading to PHP7.2.7 solved the issue for me."
    },
    {
      "id": 567059964,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-567059964",
      "created_at": "2019-12-18T14:42:08Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "cplaiu That is a generic error message that doesn’t apply to this specific\nsolution. Are you sure the MySQL server process is running? Can you connect\nfrom the command line client? Perhaps try changing between host “localhost”\nand “127.0.0.1” in config.inc.php (in case your user has access through one\nconnection type but not the other).\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 567076773,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-567076773",
      "created_at": "2019-12-18T15:20:12Z",
      "updated_at": "2019-12-19T09:03:45Z",
      "author": "Participant 7",
      "body": "> You need to change \"PASSWORD\" to the password you want. You just changed your root password literally to \"PASSWORD\" without the quotes if you used that command as is.\r\n\r\nIt's what I do.\r\n\r\nALTER USER root@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'mypassword';\r\n\r\n> cplaiu That is a generic error message that doesn’t apply to this specific solution. Are you sure the MySQL server process is running? Can you connect from the command line client? Perhaps try changing between host “localhost” and “127.0.0.1” in config.inc.php (in case your user has access through one connection type but not the other).\r\n\r\nYes I'm sure that mysql process is running, because I can connect from the CLI. I try to change “localhost” to 127.0.0.1”.\r\n\r\nnetstat -atnlp|grep -i \"3306\\|mysql\" returns:\r\n\r\ntcp6       0      0 :::33060                :::*                    LISTEN      27697/mysqld\r\ntcp6       0      0 :::3306                 :::*                    LISTEN      27697/mysqld\r\n\r\nI try to bind-address=0.0.0.0 in /etc/my.cfg\r\n\r\nBut still not working."
    },
    {
      "id": 572230216,
      "url": "https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/14220#issuecomment-572230216",
      "created_at": "2020-01-08T19:54:46Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "We've added a FAQ about this (1ae14b59a40ff5d8b62b50f9c1172dbea0e61b1f), and since this isn't a bug with phpMyAdmin I'm going to suggest we close this issue."
    }
  ],
